current_milestone.title: Expressive Capability
current_milestone.active_objective: Decide the permitted, operator-compatible provenance boundary for supplying a future Color resource after verifying that the current Existing Show has none through safe read-only inventory.

last_closed_task.result: UNSUPPORTED: fresh fingerprint-matched List Preset All returned only FOCUS rows, while List Preset Color returned Error #14 OBJECT DOES NOT EXIST; no Color preset/action resource or applicability can be proven.

next_acceptance_gate.why_it_matters: Fresh real-console evidence proves the current Show has no discoverable Color preset object. A Color action cannot be invented from fixture capability, so the next smallest blocker is an explicit provenance/Operator Workflow decision for how a future Color resource may enter a bounded case.
next_acceptance_gate.next_review_condition: Zen records which future Color-resource provenance paths may be considered, with no preset creation, palette selection, Group role assignment, or Show modification.

human_review_decisions.limitations: No numeric-ID tie-break, equal Group level, cohort saturation, Group participation count, or dimmer level may be promoted into Lighting Design knowledge or a production strategy.

evidence_results.limitations: Fixture COLOR capability and generic typed CALL_PRESET syntax do not establish a current Show Color preset, applicability, palette, role, or B3 authorization.
